name: gangplank
draw: Plank with cleats and a rope railing sloping from a dock up to the side of a boat.

name: boat-trailer
draw: Side view of a small motorboat sitting on a two-wheeled road trailer with a hitch at the front.

name: bosun-whistle
draw: Curved metal boatswain pipe with a thin tube ending in a round ball, hanging on a chain.

name: maritime-signal-flags
draw: A line of small square and triangular nautical signal flags strung diagonally on a rope.

name: foghorn
draw: Flared trumpet-shaped horn mounted on a post, with curved sound waves spreading out from its mouth.

name: engine-telegraph
draw: Ship engine order telegraph: a round dial on a pedestal with speed segments around its face and a handle lever.

name: heavy-lift-rocket
draw: Tall rocket with a central core and two slim strap-on side boosters, each ending in a flame.

name: launch-pad
draw: Rocket standing upright beside a tall lattice service tower with an access arm, on a flat pad with clouds of smoke.

name: crawler-transporter
draw: Huge flat tracked platform carrying an upright rocket on its launch tower, seen from the side.

name: rocket-engine
draw: Rocket engine close up: a combustion chamber with pipes on top of a large bell-shaped nozzle with a flame.

name: reusable-booster
draw: Slim rocket stage descending upright on a tail of flame with four landing legs unfolded, above a landing pad.

name: stage-separation
draw: Rocket splitting in two, the lower spent stage falling away as the upper stage fires its engine.

name: atmospheric-reentry
draw: Cone-shaped capsule descending base-first wrapped in a streak of flame and a glowing trail.

name: capsule-splashdown
draw: Cone-shaped space capsule floating on waves under three large round parachutes.

name: cubesat
draw: Small cube satellite with gridded solar cell faces and a thin antenna sticking out.

name: spaceplane
draw: Side view of a winged orbiter with a blunt nose, delta wings, a tail fin and engine nozzles at the back.

name: spacecraft-docking
draw: Two spacecraft modules approaching each other nose to nose with docking rings aligned between them.

name: space-elevator
draw: A long straight tether rising from a point on the Earth's curve up to a counterweight station in orbit, with a climber pod on it.

name: satellite-constellation
draw: A globe surrounded by several tilted orbit ellipses, each with a small satellite dot on it.

name: space-robotic-arm
draw: Jointed robotic arm with long segments anchored to a spacecraft hull, its end gripper reaching out.

name: airlock
draw: Round thick spacecraft hatch door with a central wheel handle, set in a square bulkhead frame.

name: astronaut-bootprint
draw: Deep ridged bootprint pressed into powdery lunar soil, drawn from above.

name: dugout-canoe
draw: Side view of a canoe carved from a single hollowed-out log, with rough bark sides and blunt rounded ends.

name: felucca
draw: Side view of a small wooden Nile sailboat with one very tall slanted yard carrying a huge triangular sail much longer than the hull.

name: racing-hydroplane
draw: Side view of a long narrow racing boat skimming on its tail with a tall rooster-tail plume of spray shooting up behind it.

name: towboat
draw: Side view of a square-bowed riverboat with a tall wheelhouse pushing a line of flat barges ahead of it.

name: sky-crane-helicopter
draw: Side view of a helicopter with a thin open spine body and no cabin behind the cockpit, a large load hanging on cables beneath it.

name: flight-instrument-panel
draw: Rectangular aircraft panel with six round gauges arranged in two rows of three.

name: livestock-railcar
draw: Side view of a rail wagon with slatted open sides and a cow's head peeking out between the slats.

name: payload-fairing
draw: Rocket top with its nose cone split open into two halves falling away, revealing a satellite inside.

name: mars-helicopter
draw: Small cube-shaped rotorcraft with two stacked long rotors on a mast and four thin splayed legs on rocky ground.

name: drone-racing-gate
draw: Square gate frame with glowing edges and a small quadcopter flying through its opening with speed lines.

name: amphibious-vehicle
draw: Side view of a boat-hulled bus on wheels driving down a ramp into the water with a splash at its bow.

name: caravel
draw: Side view of a small high-sided wooden ship with a raised stern and two or three masts each carrying a triangular lateen sail.

name: ironclad-ship
draw: Side view of a low armored steamship barely above the waterline with a single round gun turret and a short funnel.

name: air-launch-rocket
draw: Side view of a large jet carrier plane with a slim winged rocket slung under its wing.
